title: The fundamental group of a field is its absolute Galois group
statement: For a field K [def-pc-field-extension] and the geometric point Spec K^sep \to Spec K, the profinite topological group pi_1(Spec K, Spec K^sep) defined as automorphisms of the finite-etale fibre functor [def-galois-fibre-functor] is canonically isomorphic, as a topological group, to Gal(K^sep/K) with its Krull topology.

source.place: Tags 03QR and 03SF together with Fields, Section 09I: identification of the automorphism group of the fibre functor with the absolute Galois group
